```{r}
}
```

## Manual aggregation (Stochastic data)

-   1\) aggregate EWR versions \> gauges \> planning units = sdl_EWR_spells

-   2\) aggregate EWR versions \> EWRs \> gauges \> planning units = sdl_target_spells

-   calculate: ewr achieved, Maximum_interevent_duration, Variance

```{r}
# DATA
# flow chart?
# need intermediate steps?
# baseline_compare {werptoolkitr]

#------
#QAEL - WERP in house - WERP/Toolkit/macq-data-no_climate_change/aggregator_output/EWR_timeseries.csv"
EWR_timing_timeseries <- read.csv(file.path(hydro_dir_stochastic, 'aggregator_output', 'EWR_timeseries.csv')) |>
    #switch CFs:
  dplyr::mutate(event_years = ifelse(grepl("CF", ewr_code), 1-event_years, event_years))

EWR_timing_timeseries$ewr_code <- factor(EWR_timing_timeseries$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4")) 


objective_mapping <- read.csv(file.path(qaelpath, 'Toolkit','CausalNetworks', 'EWR_to_Target_mapping.csv'))
objective_mapping$ewr_code <- factor(objective_mapping$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4")) 


# Join scenario info
#-------------------
#Add temporarily the scenario info for NOW ONLY 
EWR_timing_timeseries <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  dplyr::mutate(Rainfall = as.numeric(1.0),
                Evapotranspiration = as.numeric(1.0),
                licvolfactor = as.numeric(1.0),
                Mk = as.character("Mk4"),
                Data = "Stochastic")

# Calculate Max inter-event durations
#------------------------------------
gauge_EWR_timing_spells <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  group_by(scenario, ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  dplyr::mutate(event_group = cumsum(abs(c(0, diff(event_years)))),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE))|>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name, event_group)|>
  dplyr::mutate(event_group_n = n())|>
  dplyr::filter(event_years == 0)|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(ewr_achieved = unique(ewr_achieved),  #this is right - saves making 2 separate dfs for ewr_achieved and interevent
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(event_group_n))

# obbective mapping: 
#-----------------------------------
# These grow because there's >1 'target' per Ewr_code_timing

#Target data timeseries
EWR_timing_target_timeseries <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  mutate(gauge = as.character(gauge)) |>
  left_join(objective_mapping, by = join_by(ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)) |>
  rename(env_group = target)|>
  mutate(target = case_when(      env_group == "NF" ~ "Native fish",
                                  env_group == "NV" ~ "Native vegetation" ,
                                  env_group == "OS" ~ "Other species",   
                                  env_group == "EF" ~ "Priority ecosystem function", 
                                  env_group == "WB" ~ "Waterbird",
                                  env_group == NA ~ NA))

#TIME aggregated


gauge_EWR_timing_target_spells <- gauge_EWR_timing_spells |>
  mutate(gauge = as.character(gauge)) |>
  left_join(objective_mapping, by = join_by(ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)) |>
  rename(env_group = target)|>
  mutate(target = case_when(      env_group == "NF" ~ "Native fish",
                                  env_group == "NV" ~ "Native vegetation" ,
                                  env_group == "OS" ~ "Other species",   
                                  env_group == "EF" ~ "Priority ecosystem function", 
                                  env_group == "WB" ~ "Waterbird",
                                  env_group == NA ~ NA))

#aggregate EWR versions
#----------------------
#EWR data timeseries
gauge_EWR_timeseries <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target data timeseries
gauge_EWR_target_timeseries <- EWR_timing_target_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name, env_group,
                   target)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#EWR data (time aggregated)

# THIS AGGREGATES OVER CODE_TIMING?
gauge_EWR_spells <- gauge_EWR_timing_spells |>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
          mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(Maximum_interevent_duration),
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#Target data (time aggregated)
gauge_EWR_target_spells <- gauge_EWR_timing_target_spells |>
          group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name, env_group,
                   target)|>
          reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
                  ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                  mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(Maximum_interevent_duration),
                  Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))
      
#aggregate EWRS to Target
#----------------------
#Target data timeseries
gauge_target_timeseries <- gauge_EWR_target_timeseries |>
        group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  gauge, planning_unit_name, 
                 env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between EWRs
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target data (time aggregated)
gauge_target_spells <- gauge_EWR_target_spells |>
        group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  gauge, planning_unit_name, env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between EWRs
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
                Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#aggregate gauges
#----------------------- 
#EWR timeseries
planning_unit_EWR_timeseries <- gauge_EWR_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between gauges
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target timeseries
planning_unit_target_timeseries <- gauge_target_timeseries |>
        group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  planning_unit_name, env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#EWR data

# THIS AGGREGATES TO PLANNNG UNITS?
planning_unit_EWR_spells <- gauge_EWR_spells |>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between gauges
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
          mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#Target data
planning_unit_target_spells <- gauge_target_spells |>
        group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  planning_unit_name, env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
                Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#aggregate planning units - ONLY have one sdl 
#--------------------------------------------
#EWR timeseries 
sdl_EWR_timeseries <- planning_unit_EWR_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
          n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target timeseries
sdl_target_timeseries <- planning_unit_target_timeseries |>
        group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
                n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))
      
#EWR data - irrespective of Targets 
sdl_EWR_spells <- planning_unit_EWR_spells |>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
          n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
          mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#Target data
      sdl_target_spells <- planning_unit_target_spells |>
        group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
                n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
                Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

```

## Manual aggregation (Historic data)

```{r}
EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4 <- read.csv(file.path(Mk4_dir, "aggregator_output", 'EWR_timeseries.csv'))|>
    #switch CFs:
  dplyr::mutate(event_years = ifelse(grepl("CF", ewr_code), 1-event_years, event_years)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(EWR_switch = ifelse(grepl("CF", ewr_code), T, F))
  
EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4$ewr_code <- factor(EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4"))

objective_mapping$ewr_code <- factor(objective_mapping$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4"))

  reframe(ewr_achieved = unique(ewr_achieved),  #this is right - saves making 2 separate dfs for ewr_achieved and interevent
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(event_group_n))
```

## Calculate confidence intervals for CDF

```{r}
sdl_EWR_ecdf <- sdl_EWR_timeseries|>
  ungroup()|>
  select(-year)|>
  group_by(Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, scenario)|> #YES SCENARIO!
  mutate(ewr_achieved_group = round(ewr_achieved, 2))|>
  arrange(ewr_achieved)|>  
  mutate(ecdf_val = ecdf(ewr_achieved)(ewr_achieved))|>
  tibble()|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_achieved_group)|> #NOT SCENARIO!
  mutate(ecdf_mean = mean(ecdf_val),
         cdf_lsd = ecdf_mean - 2*sd(ecdf_val),
         cdf_usd = ecdf_mean + 2*sd(ecdf_val))

# 
# temp <- quantreg::rq(sdl_EWR_timeseries, tau = 0.95)
# quantile(95)
```

## Adjusting stochastic results to have median = to historic

```{r}
 sdl_EWR_spells_adjusted <-  sdl_EWR_spells |>
   #filter(names_CSIRO_climate_scenario != "Historical climate")|>
   left_join(sdl_EWR_spells_MK4_historic, by = "ewr_code")|>
   group_by(ewr_code)|>
   mutate(median_ewr_achieved = median(ewr_achieved))|>
   mutate(adj_ewr_achieved = ewr_achieved - (median_ewr_achieved-historic_ewr_achieved))
 
 sdl_target_spells_adjusted <-  sdl_target_spells |>
   #filter(names_CSIRO_climate_scenario != "Historical climate")|>
   left_join(sdl_target_spells_MK4_historic, by = "env_group")|>
   group_by(env_group)|>
   mutate(median_ewr_achieved = median(ewr_achieved))|>
   mutate(adj_ewr_achieved = ewr_achieved - (median_ewr_achieved-historic_ewr_achieved))
```

```{r}
                           owner == "VIC - Department of Environment, Land, Water and Planning"~ "VIC",
                           owner == "SA - Department of Environment, Water and Natural Resources"~ "SA",
                           owner == "QLD - Department of Natural Resources, Mines and Energy"~ "QLD",
                           owner == NA ~ NA))

Map_Macquarie <- ggplot(data = sdl_units,  aes(geometry = geometry)) +
  geom_sf(fill = "white")+
  geom_sf(data = filter(gauges_df, gauge %in% gauges_to_plot),  aes(geometry = geometry), colour = "#fcaa20")+
  geom_sf(data = filter(sdl_units, SWSDLName == SWSDLName_subset),  aes(geometry = geometry), fill = "#fcaa20", colour = "#fcaa20", alpha = 0.1)+ 
  geom_sf_text(data = filter(sdl_units, SWSDLName == SWSDLName_subset), aes(label = SWSDLName), colour = "#fcaa20") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme_werp_toolkit(legend.position = "none")

Map_Macquarie

ggsave(plot = Map_Macquarie, filename = file.path(comp_results, paste0("Map_Macquarie", Sys.Date(), ".tiff")), device = "tiff",
       width = 8, height = 5)
```

## 1) Vulnerability - historic data - no climate change (to add to the bottom of stochastic v.)

```{r}
#filter filenames
files_sdl_EWR_vulnerability <- files_EWR_all |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl('sdl_ewr_vulnerability/', filename))|>
  dplyr::filter(grepl('licvolfactor_1_0/', filename))|>
  dplyr::filter(grepl('r1_0_e1_0/', filename))|>
  dplyr::filter(grepl('MACQ_CC_EFR_mkiv/', filename))

files_sdl_EWR_vulnerability <- list(files_sdl_EWR_vulnerability$filename)

#load in data
sdl_EWR_vulnerability <- do.call(rbind,
          lapply(files_sdl_EWR_vulnerability[[1]][1], read_plus_rds))

for (i in 2:length(files_sdl_EWR_vulnerability)) {
  Merged_temp <- do.call(rbind,
          lapply(files_sdl_EWR_vulnerability[[1]][i], read_plus_rds))
  
sdl_EWR_vulnerability <- rbind(sdl_EWR_vulnerability, Merged_temp)
}

#select measure
sdl_EWR_vulnerability$ewr_achieved <- sdl_EWR_vulnerability$replicates_ArithmeticMean_sdl_units_ArithmeticMean_planning_units_ArithmeticMean_ewr_code_ArithmeticMean_all_time_ArithmeticMean_ewr_achieved
sdl_EWR_vulnerability$EWR_scenario_Variance <- sdl_EWR_vulnerability$replicates_Variance_sdl_units_ArithmeticMean_planning_units_ArithmeticMean_ewr_code_ArithmeticMean_all_time_ArithmeticMean_ewr_achieved

plot_sdl_EWR_vulnerability <- ggplot(data = sdl_EWR_vulnerability, aes(y = EWR_scenario_Variance, x = ewr_achieved, colour = ewr_code, shape = Data)) + 
  geom_point() +
  theme_werp_toolkit()+
  theme(legend.box = "horizontal")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean(sdl_EWR_vulnerability$EWR_scenario_Variance)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_EWR)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_data2)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0 , 0.003))

plot_sdl_target_vulnerability_MK4 <- sdl_target_vulnerability_MK4 |>
  mutate(EWR_scenario_Variance = 0)|>
  filter(Evapotranspiration == 1.00 & Rainfall== 1.0 & licvolfactor == 1.0)|>
  ggplot(aes(y = EWR_scenario_Variance, x = ewr_achieved, colour = env_group, shape = Data)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = sdl_target_vulnerability) +
  #geom_hex()#+
  #facet_wrap(~target)+
  theme_werp_toolkit()+
  theme(legend.box = "horizontal")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(sdl_EWR_vulnerability$EWR_scenario_Variance)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_envgroup)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_data2)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0 , 0.003))


plot_sdl_vulnerability_MK4 <- plot_sdl_EWR_vulnerability_MK4 + plot_sdl_target_vulnerability_MK4 + plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.box = "horizontal")

plot_sdl_vulnerability_MK4
```

## NULL DATA

```{r}

null_data <- data.frame(
  ewr_achieved = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.01),
  ewr_code = "CF",
  env_group = "NF",
  Data = "Null model")

null_data <- null_data |>
  mutate(n_years_achieved = 130*ewr_achieved,
         n_years_not_achieved = 130*(1-ewr_achieved),
         mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = n_years_not_achieved/n_years_achieved)|>
  mutate(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = ifelse(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration == Inf, 130, mean_Maximum_interevent_duration))
```

```{r}
sdl_target_spells_HD <- sdl_target_spells
sdl_target_spells_HD$names_CSIRO_climate_scenario <- "Hot and Dry"


sdl_target_spells_background <- bind_rows(sdl_target_spells, sdl_target_spells_JW, sdl_target_spells_HW, sdl_target_spells_JH,
                                      sdl_target_spells_JD, sdl_target_spells_HD)

sdl_target_spells_background$names_CSIRO_climate_scenario <- factor(sdl_target_spells_background$names_CSIRO_climate_scenario, 
           levels = c("Just Wet", "Hot and Wet", "Historical climate", "Just Hot", "Just Dry", "Hot and Dry")) 
```
